ABOUT THE APPROACH

Playful form.
Purposeful movement.

Jules Ito is an illustrative motion-designer identity for this collection. The work explores identity systems, typographic pacing and expressive geometric movement. No real client list, biography or professional credentials were provided.

Reduced-motion preferences are respected: the reel begins paused, and in reduced-motion mode it stays scrub-only. No audio plays at any time.
